scope: Local isolated Controller/HA/Supervisor protocol fixtures and real Chromium against synthetic household data; not a release-media or physical-device acceptance.

backend.skips: One real Core OAuth case, one packaged desktop login case, four container compatibility cases; deferred to exact-source CI.

screenshots.rerun: One already-covered browser case rerun to retain screenshots; not added to the independent test count.

limitations: Native HA login/pairing is still required; no complete chat-only setup.
Discovery reads HA candidates only with current-message opt-in; no LAN scan.
Successful logout is durably revoked; failed disk commits do not claim successful logout.
Old stateless cookies require login after upgrade; older binaries do not enforce the new revocation contract.

ci_attempts.cause: Desktop login fixtures omitted the private access key created by host/install.py; updated fixtures preserve all rejection/replay assertions.

desktop_handoff.container: actual freshly built Controller; network=none; removed in finally
